Highlights:
Below you will find the product specifications and the manual specifications for the Asrock Z790 PG-ITX/TB4.

The Asrock Z790 PG-ITX/TB4 is a motherboard designed for use with Intel processors. It features the LGA 1700 processor socket and is compatible with Intel Core i5, i7, and i9 processors. This motherboard supports a maximum of one SMP processor. In terms of memory slots, the Asrock Z790 PG-ITX/TB4 has two DIMM slots. It can accommodate a maximum of 64 GB of internal memory. The memory slots support non-ECC and unbuffered memory. When it comes to storage drive compatibility, this motherboard supports both HDD and SSD drives. The supported storage drive interfaces include M.2 and SATA III. Additionally, the Asrock Z790 PG-ITX/TB4 offers RAID support, with RAID levels 0, 1, and 5 available. Overall, the Asrock Z790 PG-ITX/TB4 is a versatile motherboard that provides support for Intel processors and offers various storage options. It is equipped with two DIMM slots for memory expansion, allowing a maximum of 64 GB of internal memory. With its compatibility with both HDD and SSD drives, users have the flexibility to choose the storage solution that best suits their needs. Additionally, the motherboard's RAID support further enhances data storage capabilities. The Asrock Z790 PG-ITX/TB4 is a reliable and high-performance motherboard suitable for various computing applications.
